# UGC rights request and release templates

Service 18. v1, 21 Oct 2026. Rights levels R1 to R4 are defined in `playbook.md` §8.
These templates are a starting point. Client legal approves the final release form per market (approval kind `contract`, gate G4). Not legal advice.

## U1 Social comment / DM request (R1, organic repost)

> Love this, @{{handle}}! May we share it on {{brand_handle}} with credit to you? Reply #Yes{{BrandTag}} to agree to our terms: {{terms_link}}

Rules: the hashtag reply is valid only for R1. The agent stores a screenshot and the reply URL in the rights record. Never repost before the reply.

## U2 Email request for owned channels (R2)

**Subject:** Can we feature your photo?

> Hi {{first_name}},
>
> We saw your {{content_type}} of {{product_short_name}} and we love it. Could we show it on our website, product pages and emails, with credit to you?
>
> What you agree to:
> - Where: {{brand_name}} website, product pages, emails and our own social accounts
> - Where not: paid ads (we will ask separately if we would like that)
> - How long: {{duration_months}} months, and you can ask us to stop at any time
> - Credit: {{credit_format}}
>
> [Review and sign (1 minute)]({{esign_link}})
>
> If other people appear in the {{content_type}}, they also need to agree. The form explains how.
>
> Thank you,
> {{signoff_name}}

## U3 Paid ads request (R3)

> Hi {{first_name}},
>
> Your {{content_type}} works really well, and we would like to use it in paid ads on {{platforms}} in {{countries}} for {{duration_months}} months.
>
> We offer {{payment_or_product}} for this. You keep ownership of your content.
>
> [See the full terms and sign]({{esign_link}})

Rules: the offer amount comes only from the approved rate card. A person approves the deal before the link is sent (gate G4, kind `contract`) and approves the payment (kind `payout`). The ad carries the local paid label. For whitelisting (ads from the creator's handle), the form names the account access and how it ends.

## U4 B2B case study request (R4)

> Hi {{first_name}},
>
> The results your team got with {{product}} ({{headline_result}}) would help other {{industry}} teams. Would you and {{company}} be open to a short case study?
>
> It needs about 30 minutes of interview time. You approve every word before we publish, and we need sign-off from someone at {{company}} who can approve use of the company name and logo.

## Release form: required fields (all markets)

1. Owner name, handle, email, country.
2. Description and link of the content, file hash.
3. Every person shown: name, consent, age 18 or over (yes / no). If no: guardian name and signature.
4. Rights level (R1 to R4), channels, countries, start and end dates.
5. Payment or product, if any, and the disclosure it triggers.
6. Permission to edit: crop, caption, subtitles, colour only. No change to meaning. No AI changes to faces or voices.
7. Withdrawal: how to ask; we remove from live use within 30 days (paid ads already bought may run to the end of the agreed flight if the law of the market allows; client legal decides).
8. Local additions: right of publicity release (US), French version (Quebec), GDPR notice (EU, UK), Arabic version and licence check for paid posts (GCC).
